brief:
The Central Elections Commission and Independent Commission for Human Rights renewed their Memorandum of Understanding on Sunday, according to Palestine News Network, establishing a partnership framework to protect freedoms and liberties during legislative elections. The agreement also involves the Civil Coalition for Elections Support in coordinating election oversight efforts.

The renewed MoU formalizes cooperation between the two Palestinian bodies ahead of planned legislative polling. Election monitoring agreements typically outline responsibilities for observing voting procedures, documenting irregularities, and ensuring compliance with electoral law. The CEC and ICHR have maintained their partnership through previous election cycles to strengthen institutional safeguards during the electoral process.
